name: dynamite-pack-blast
description: D-124 (was D-108): the Deep North Dynamite Pack is set down and lit like a stick; the countdown shows; the 4 s fuse ends in one blast that breaks a gold vein 8 m and an Ashlands fortress pillar 12 m away (tier 5 rocks of 50 and 500 per part; the Deep North gammel troll DN_gammeltrollFrac01 is not a spawnable prefab in this game version), fells a beech at 17 m, leaves a beech at 24 m standing (20 m reach), hurts and burns a Troll only a little (creatures 20 % + fire) and digs a crater.
